rationale: The stock gapped down ~13.5% on severely negative fundamental news (projected EPS -$0.31, revenue -47%), and within the first minute the price is sitting at 7.9% of today's range — essentially at the low — with no clear directional resolution yet. The single 1-minute candle available shows a wide range (11.13–11.32) with a close near the middle, offering no reliable entry signal for either a bounce or continuation short. With high uncertainty about whether the gap-down selling is exhausted or will continue, and insufficient price structure to define a high-probability setup, the risk/reward does not justify a position at this moment.
